question: Which yoginī is listed after the flower-bowed figure joined with his beloved in quarrel?
inference: The verse lists Kāṅkṣiṇī among the named figures after the flower-bowed one joined with his beloved in quarrel.
uncertainties: The exact doctrinal role of Kāṅkṣiṇī is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: Quarrel with the beloved, joined; the flower-bowed one; and Kāṅkṣiṇī.
